SELECT pi_no, SUM(pending) pending, SUM(CASE WHEN pending = 0 AND to_push = 0 THEN n ELSE 0 END) allocated, SUM(transferred_in) transferred_in, SUM(unbatched) unbatched, SUM(suspended) suspended FROM ( SELECT pi_no, COUNT(*) n, SUM(status = 'PENDING_ALLOC') pending, SUM(status = 'TO_PUSH') to_push, SUM(seq_pi_no <> '' AND seq_pi_no <> pi_no) transferred_in, SUM(status = 'TO_PUSH' AND delivery_batch_no IS NULL AND suspend IS NULL) unbatched, SUM(suspend IS NOT NULL) suspended FROM sn_item WHERE pi_no IN #{p} AND origin = 'GEN'
GROUP BY pi_no, bill_no ) g GROUP BY pi_no

SELECT pi_no, COUNT(*) n FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE batch_type <> 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND pi_no IN #{p} AND (result = 'FAILED' OR (result = 'UNCONFIRMED' AND push_state = 'EXHAUSTED'))
GROUP BY pi_no
SELECT task_key, COUNT(*) n FROM sn_push_task WHERE task_key IN #{p} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING') GROUP BY task_key
SELECT * FROM sn_gen_job WHERE running_pi IN #{p}
SELECT bill_no, bill_seq, SUM(status = 'PENDING_ALLOC') pending, SUM(status = 'TO_PUSH') to_push, MIN(sn) a, MAX(sn) b FROM sn_item WHERE pi_no = #{pi} AND origin = 'GEN' GROUP BY bill_no, bill_seq
